price_note: $269 per 2-pack (only 2-packs available) = $134.50/wheel; single listed $139 but out of stock. BotWheel+S1 kit $279 (out of stock).

specs.interface: 3-phase + hall + encoder harness (JST PUD, ODrive S1 pinout)
specs.encoder: hall sensors + built-in 3200 CPR incremental encoder (not absolute; hall used for commutation at boot)
specs.driver_needed: ODrive S1 ($149, out of stock) or ODrive Pro ($229) or moteus n1 ($149, quadrature + hall aux)
specs.axle: fixed flange 4x M6 on dia 36 PCD, dia 50 boss, cable exits centre one side (single-sided)
specs.tyre: patterned tread; solid vs pneumatic not stated
specs.calc_basis: top speed from no_load_speed_rpm at voltage_nominal_v; force from peak_torque_nm / wheel radius

notes: peak_torque_nm (14.3) and no_load_speed_rpm (209) are DERIVED, not published: 15 A peak (3 s) x Kt 0.951 and Kv 8.7 x 24 V. Rated load 80 kg per wheel. Ship origin not stated (US store, tariff surcharge on some products). Best-documented, easiest-to-buy chunky hub with a real encoder.
